newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 13.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories:

WASHINGTON - USAir will change its name to US Airways and refurbish its fleet in an effort to improve its image, but the company's chairman says the airline needs a cost-cutting agreement with its unions.
WASHINGTON - An order from the city's Public Service Commission means Bell Atlantic will take as much as $1.15 of D.C. customers' phone bills, retroactive to last January.

WASHINGTON - Sunbeam Corp. will eliminate half of its 12,000-person work force, reduce the number of factories from 26 to eight, sell off several divisions and trim product lines under a new restructuring plan.
WASHINGTON - Three African American women are suing Avis Rent-a-Car System Inc. and one of its franchise owners, alleging racial discrimination.
